docs.title: LuckyPick EuroMillions
docs.text:
Version 1.0 100% Ad-Free iOS & Android

Welcome to the official technical and product documentation for LuckyPick EuroMillions.

docs.title: Project Goal
docs.text:
The primary goal of LuckyPick EuroMillions is to create the premier companion application for EuroMillions lottery players across Europe. The application seamlessly combines a sleek Dark Blue & Gold modern design with useful lottery tools, advanced statistics, and unique personalized number generation logic ("Lucky Modes").

graph TD
    User([EuroMillions Player]) --> App[LuckyPick Mobile App]
    App --> Gen[Lucky Modes Engine]
    App --> Check[My Picks Ticket Checker]
    App --> Stats[Draw History & Frequency Stats]

    Backend[Scraper & API Server] -->|Tue/Fri Draw Data| App
    Backend -->|Push Notifications| User

docs.title: Key Differentiators
docs.text:
• 100% Advertising-Free: Zero intrusive banner ads or modal video pop-ups.
  • Personalized Lucky Modes: Generates ticket combinations using birthdays, zodiac signs, pet names, family milestones, and historical frequency logic.
  • Smart Ticket Checker: Auto-validates saved ticket combinations against published draw results, calculating winnings across all 13 official prize tiers.
  • High Jackpot Push Alerts: Instant notifications when EuroMillions jackpots hit landmark sums (e.g. €100 Million+).
  • Privacy-First Sharing: Share custom lucky cards without exposing personal birthdays or names.

docs.title: Key Design Decisions

docs.title: 2.1 draws Table (Core — 100-row rolling window)
docs.text:
CREATE TABLE draws (
    id              UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    draw_date       DATE NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    main_numbers    INTEGER[5] NOT NULL,   -- sorted ascending, values 1–50
    lucky_stars     INTEGER[2] NOT NULL,   -- sorted ascending, values 1–12
    jackpot_won     BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    jackpot_winners INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    is_validated    BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    prize_pending   BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    published_at    TIMESTAMPTZ,

    CONSTRAINT main_count CHECK (array_length(main_numbers, 1) = 5),
    CONSTRAINT star_count  CHECK (array_length(lucky_stars, 1) = 2)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_draws_date ON draws(draw_date DESC);

docs.title: 4. Generation Engine Design
docs.text: The engine runs entirely client-side in Dart. No network call required to generate a combination.

docs.title: 4.1 Core Validation Rules (applied to every mode)
docs.text:
HARD RULES — enforced before any combination is displayed or saved:

1. main_numbers.length == 5
2. main_numbers.every((n) => n >= 1 && n <= 50)
3. main_numbers.toSet().length == 5          // all unique
4. lucky_stars.length == 2
5. lucky_stars.every((s) => s >= 1 && s <= 12)
6. lucky_stars.toSet().length == 2           // all unique
7. !isDuplicateInSession(combination)

docs.title: 4.2 Immediate Exclusion Protocol
docs.text:
All modes use this protocol to guarantee no duplicate numbers within a single combination:

selectedPool = full range (1–50 for main, 1–12 for stars)

docs.title: Lucky Modes & Number Generation Logic
docs.text: EuroMillions requires selecting 5 Main Numbers (1 to 50) and 2 Lucky Stars (1 to 12). LuckyPick features proprietary Lucky Modes that personalize and optimize this selection.

docs.title: 1. EuroMillions Rules & Constraints
docs.text:
EuroMillions Combination Rules                

    Main Numbers:  [ 5 ] numbers chosen from 1 to 50         
    Lucky Stars:   [ 2 ] numbers chosen from 1 to 12
  • No duplicates within a line: 5 main numbers must all be distinct; 2 lucky stars must be distinct.
  • Ascending order display: All generated lines are displayed sorted in ascending numerical order.

docs.title: 2. Birthday Mode
docs.text: Converts meaningful personal dates (birthdays, anniversaries, graduation years) into EuroMillions numbers.

docs.title: Algorithm Rules:
docs.text:
1. Direct mapping: Days (1–31) and Months (1–12) directly map to Main Numbers and Lucky Stars.
  2. Year mapping: Digits of birth years (e.g. 1994 $\rightarrow$ 19, 94 $\rightarrow$ 49) are modulo-mapped to valid 1–50 and 1–12 ranges.
  3. Entropy filler: If date inputs yield fewer than 5 unique main numbers, high-entropy pseudorandom numbers fill the remaining slots.

docs.title: 3. Horoscope / Zodiac Mode
docs.text:
Generates daily personalized combinations based on the user's astrological sign.

Zodiac Input (e.g. Leo)  Astrological Ruling Numbers + Ephemeris  5 Main + 2 Stars
  • 12 Astrological Signs Supported: Aries, Taurus, Gemini, Cancer, Leo, Virgo, Libra, Scorpio, Sagittarius, Capricorn, Aquarius, Pisces.
  • Daily Refresh: Number combinations update daily based on planetary house positions and sign ruling numbers.

docs.title: 4. Pet & Family Modes
docs.text:
• Pet Mode: Uses pet name letter values, pet adoption/birth dates, and pet category (Dog, Cat, Bird, etc.) to derive a unique 5+2 combination.
  • Family Mode: Combines multiple family members' ages, birth months, and lucky digits into a combined ticket set.

docs.title: 5. Frequency & Hot / Cold Mode
docs.text: Leverages the rolling 100-draw EuroMillions database to generate statistics-backed combinations.

docs.title: Selection Strategies:
docs.text:
1. Hot Numbers: Picks from the most frequently drawn numbers in the last 100 draws.
  2. Cold / Overdue Numbers: Picks from numbers that have not appeared in the longest duration.

docs.title: 3. Automated Draw Scraper
docs.text:
Runs on a cron — Tuesday and Friday at 20:45 CET (shortly after draw close, results typically published 21:00–21:30 CET).

Cron schedule: 

45 20 * * 2,5   /usr/local/bin/luckypick-scraper

Scraper logic:

1. Fetch official results from Belgian National Lottery or EuroMillions API
2. Parse draw date, 5 main numbers, 2 Lucky Stars
3. Check draws table — skip if draw_date already exists
4. INSERT draw record (numbers + lucky_stars; jackpot_eur may be null initially)
5. Attempt to fetch prize tier data; INSERT prize_tiers if available
6. Rebuild statistics table:
     a. Pull last 100 draw dates
     b. Count frequency of each number (1–50) and star (1–12)
     c. Count frequency in last 20 draws
     d. Compute trend_score per number
     e. UPSERT statistics rows
7. Invalidate Redis keys: draw:latest, statistics:main, statistics:stars
8. Dispatch push notifications (see §4)
9. Log result to scraper_runs

Error handling:

  • Retry up to 3 times with 5-minute backoff if HTTP fetch fails
  • If prize data unavailable after 3 retries, store draw without prizes; a second cron at 00:00 CET re-attempts prize fetch only
  • Alert (email / Slack) on 3 consecutive scraper_runs.status = 'failed'

docs.title: Dispatch Logic
docs.text:
For each notification type that fires:
  1. Query users WHERE notification_setting_{type} = true
  2. Split by platform (ios / android)
  3. iOS: FCM HTTP v1 → APNs gateway  OR  APNs direct
  4. Android: FCM HTTP v1 → Firebase → device
  5. Handle invalid token responses → remove stale tokens from users table
  6. Log batch result (sent / failed / invalid token)

Batch size: send in batches of 500 tokens per FCM request to stay within rate limits.

docs.title: iOS — StoreKit 2 (JWS)
docs.text:
POST /usr/iap/validate/ios
Body: { "transaction_jws": "<signed_transaction>" }

1. Decode JWS header → fetch Apple root certificate
2. Verify signature chain
3. Extract productId, originalTransactionId, purchaseDate, expiresDate
4. UPSERT subscriptions row
5. Update user subscription status
6. Return: { "is_premium": true, "expires_at": "..." }

Apple Server Notifications webhook handles renewals, cancellations, refunds automatically.

docs.title: Android — Google Play Billing v6
docs.text:
POST /usr/iap/validate/android
Body: { "purchase_token": "...", "product_id": "..." }

1. Call Google Play Developer API:
   GET purchases.subscriptions.get or purchases.products.get
2. Verify purchaseState = 0 (Purchased)
3. UPSERT subscriptions row
4. Return: { "is_premium": true, "expires_at": "..." }

Google Play Real-Time Developer Notifications (Pub/Sub webhook) handles renewals and cancellations.

docs.text:
• All /usr/* routes validate JWT expiry and signature before processing
  • IAP validation always calls Apple / Google — never trust client-side receipts alone
  • Rate limit free pick consumption endpoint (max 3 per user per day, enforced server-side)

docs.title: Splash Screen
docs.text:
• Short branded splash (~1 second)
  • LuckyPick logo centred on dark navy background
  • No interaction — auto-advances to Welcome

docs.title: Welcome Screen
docs.text:
• Single screen — no multi-step onboarding
  • Clear GET STARTED primary button
  • Language auto-detection indicator
  • Legal disclaimer at the bottom (small, readable): "LuckyPick is an independent application and is not affiliated with EuroMillions or any official lottery operator."
  • Discreet notification permission pre-prompt (optional, before OS dialog)

docs.title: Main Home
docs.text:
• GENERATE MY NUMBERS primary action button (prominent, aurora/gold)
  • Free pick counter visible: "3 free picks remaining today"
  • Horizontal scroll preview of Lucky Modes (Birthday · Horoscope · Pet · Family)
  • View All Lucky Modes → link
  • Discover Premium section (tasteful, never aggressive)
  • No separate jackpot amount display — results are in the Results tab

docs.title: Generated Numbers Screen
docs.text:
• 1–1.5 second reveal animation
  • 5 main number balls + 2 Lucky Stars displayed
  • Lucky Mode badge (e.g. "Horoscope Mode — Leo")
  • Three actions below: Save · Generate Again · Share

docs.title: Free Limit Reached State
docs.text:
• Friendly message: "You've used your 3 free Lucky Picks for today. Come back tomorrow or unlock Premium."
  • UNLOCK PREMIUM CTA
  • No negative / punishing tone

docs.title: Lucky Modes Browser
docs.text:
• Grid or list of all 10 Premium Modes + Quick Pick
  • Each mode has its own icon and a short one-line description (revealed on tap, not always visible)
  • Premium modes show a gold PREMIUM label — no large padlock icons
  • Free users can tap any premium mode and read the description before seeing the upgrade prompt

docs.title: Mode Input Screens (one per mode)
docs.text: Mode Input Fields UX Notes Birthday Mode Name/Nickname (optional), Date of Birth (DD/MM/YYYY) Date picker; must transform internally — not raw day/month Horoscope Mode Day + Month only (no year) Auto-displays detected zodiac sign Pet Mode Pet Name, Animal Type (7 options) Animal type as tappable pill buttons; CHANGE PET option Family Mode Relationship selector + Name + DOB per member +ADD FAMILY MEMBER button; relationship dropdown with "Other → specify" field; EDIT FAMILY / START NEW FAMILY Lucky Color Mode 10 circular colour buttons (identical size/shape) SURPRISE ME button; selected circle gets subtle gold outline; colour must NOT change generated ball colours Lucky Number Mode 1–3 numbers (1–50) Number input with validation; selected numbers shown as chips; CHANGE LUCKY NUMBERS Hot / Cold / Trending / Smart Mix No personal input Stat-mode description only; GENERATE button

docs.title: Mode Result Screen (shared layout)
docs.text:
• Shows the 5+2 combination result
  • Lucky Mode + personal label (e.g. "Pet Mode – Charlie")
  • ADD TO MY PICKS · GENERATE ANOTHER · CHOOSE ANOTHER MODE · CHANGE DETAILS · SHARE
  • Counter shows current My Picks total

docs.title: My Picks Screen (Active Set)
docs.text:
• Header: MY PICKS + combination count (e.g. "6 combinations")
  • Each combination shows: mode label · 5 main numbers · 2 Lucky Stars
  • Per-item ••• menu: Replace Combination · Remove Combination · Share LuckyPick
  • START NEW SET button (available as soon as 1 combination exists)
  • At 12 combinations: SET COMPLETE state with START NEW SET CTA

docs.title: Empty My Picks State
docs.text:
• "No combinations yet"
  • CREATE YOUR FIRST LUCKY PICK button

docs.title: Saved Sets Screen
docs.text:
• List of archived sets by date (e.g. "8 August 2026 – 6 combinations")
  • Tap to expand and view combinations with mode labels

docs.title: Results Screen
docs.text:
• Latest draw shown immediately on open — no tap required
  • Draw Date + 5 main number balls + 2 Lucky Stars (official ball/star visual style)
  • PRIZE BREAKDOWN section below: Tier · Prize Amount · Number of Winners (all available tiers)
  • "Prize information pending" state when numbers are published but prize data not yet available
  • Link to Draw History

docs.title: Draw History Screen
docs.text:
• List of last 100 draws, newest first
  • Each row: Date + 5 numbers + 2 Stars
  • Tap any row to open Draw Detail

docs.title: Draw Detail Screen
docs.text:
• Same layout as Results Screen
  • Full prize breakdown for that specific draw
  • ← Back to Draw History

docs.title: 6. Statistics Screen
docs.text:
• HOT NUMBERS — top 10 most frequent main numbers (last 100 draws)
  • COLD NUMBERS — bottom 10 least frequent
  • TRENDING — numbers with strongest recent uplift (last 20 vs 100 draws)
  • NUMBER FREQUENCY — frequency chart/bar for all 50 main numbers
  • LUCKY STAR FREQUENCY — frequency for all 12 Lucky Stars
  • Free users: limited preview of top 5 numbers only
  • Premium users: full statistics
  • Disclaimer always visible: "Historical frequency does not predict future results"

docs.title: 7. Notifications Settings
docs.text:
• Three independent toggles (ON/OFF):
  • Draw Reminders
  • Results Available
  • Jackpot Won
  • Available to Free and Premium users
  • No separate toggle for €100M+ High Jackpot (it is a variant of Draw Reminder)

docs.title: Premium Screen (Central — all entry points lead here)
docs.text:
• Headline: "Make LuckyPick truly yours."
  • Benefits list: All 10 Lucky Modes · Unlimited Generations · Advanced Statistics · Unlimited My Picks · Future Premium Features
  • Three plan options:
  • MONTHLY — €8.99/mo, auto-renews
  • YEARLY — BEST VALUE — €79.99/yr, visually highlighted in gold, "SAVE ~26%"
  • LIFETIME — €179.99 once, no subscription
  • Clearly visible ✕ / Back button — no dark patterns
  • RESTORE PURCHASES link at bottom

Do NOT include

  • "No Ads" as a Premium benefit (LuckyPick is ad-free for everyone)
  • Fake countdown timers or urgency messages
  • Hidden close buttons

docs.title: Post-Purchase Confirmation Screen
docs.text:
• "Welcome to LuckyPick Premium. Premium is now active."
  • CONTINUE button — returns user directly to the feature they came from

docs.title: 9. Social Sharing Flow
docs.text:
• After tapping SHARE, the device native share sheet opens automatically
  • No template selection required — LuckyPick generates the card automatically
  • After sharing: stay on current result, preserve combination and My Picks
